results.name: Dumbbell Seated Shoulder Press Parallel Grip
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support. Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, with your elbows bent at 90 degrees at chest level, facing forward, and your palms facing each other (parallel grip).
Press the dumbbells upward by extending your elbows, until your arms are fully extended above your head.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement, ensuring that your arms are straight but not locked.
Lower the dumbbells back to starting position following the steps in reverse. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your back firmly pressed against the bench to support your spine.
Engage your core muscles throughout the exercise to maintain stability.
Exhale as you press the dumbbells upward and inhale as you lower them.
results.description: Dumbbell Seated Shoulder Press Parallel Grip is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps.

results.name: Dumbbell Seated Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back supported, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height with your palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended above your head.
Pause briefly at the top, ensuring your arms are straight but not locked.
Lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your back firmly against the bench to support your spine.
Engage your core throughout the exercise to maintain stability.
Exhale as you press the dumbbells up and inhale as you lower them.
results.description: Dumbbell Seated Shoulder Press is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps.

results.name: Dumbbell Seated on Exercise Ball Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder level with your palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended above your head.
Briefly hold the position at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to shoulder level.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you press the dumbbells up and inhale as you lower them.
Use a controlled motion to prevent any jerking or swinging.
Ensure your feet are firmly planted on the floor to maintain balance.
results.description: Dumbbell Seated on Exercise Ball Shoulder Press is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps.

results.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Extension
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand using a neutral grip. Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor, allowing your arms to hang below your shoulders.
Keep your elbows slightly bent and raise both dumbbells backward by extending your arms behind your hips.
Pause briefly at the top and squeeze the backs of your shoulders while keeping your torso still.
Slowly lower the dumbbells until they hang below your shoulders, then repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep the bend in your elbows fixed without turning the exercise into a row.
Move your arms backward from your shoulders rather than swinging the dumbbells.
Keep your torso still and avoid rising as you lift the weights.
Exhale as you raise the dumbbells and inhale as you lower them.
results.description: Dumbbell Shoulder Extension is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Upper Back, Core.

results.name: Dumbbell Shrugs
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your arms fully extended by your sides. Your palms should be facing your thighs.
Raise your shoulders towards your ears by contracting your trapezius muscles, lifting the dumbbells without bending your elbows.
Hold the contraction at the top for a brief moment, squeezing your trapezius muscles.
Lower your shoulders back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your back straight and avoid using momentum to lift the dumbbells.
Focus on lifting your shoulders straight up rather than rolling them forward or backward.
Exhale as you lift your shoulders and inhale as you lower them.
results.description: Dumbbell Shrugs is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the traps (back). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders.

results.name: Dumbbell Side Lying One Hand Raise
instructions: Lie on your right side on a bench, with your legs stacked and your right elbow on the bench for support. Hold a dumbbell in your left hand with your arm resting along your left side.
Slowly raise the dumbbell towards the ceiling, keeping your arm straight until it is fully extended.
Lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position in a controlled manner, focusing on engaging your shoulder muscles throughout the movement.
Repeat the exercise for the desired number of repetitions on your left side.
tips: Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and prevent your torso from rotating.
Use a slow and controlled motion to maximize muscle engagement and reduce the risk of injury.
Focus on breathing steadily, exhaling as you lift the dumbbell and inhaling as you lower it.
results.description: Dumbbell Side Lying One Hand Raise is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Dumbbell Silverback Shrug
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand using an overhand grip. Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward while keeping your back straight and your arms hanging below your shoulders.
Keep your elbows straight and raise both shoulders toward your ears, allowing the dumbbells to move slightly upward.
Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your upper back without lifting your torso.
Slowly lower your shoulders until your arms hang fully extended, then repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your elbows straight and avoid rowing or curling the weights.
Allow your shoulders to lower fully between repetitions without rounding your spine.
Keep your knees slightly bent and maintain the same hip-hinge position.
Exhale as you raise your shoulders and inhale as you lower them.
results.description: Dumbbell Silverback Shrug is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the traps (back). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Shoulders, Forearms.

results.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Underhand Front Raise
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in your right hand with an underhand grip (palm facing forward). Let your arm hang straight down at your side.
Slowly raise the dumbbell in front of you to shoulder height, keeping your arm straight and your palm facing up.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement, ensuring your arm is parallel to the floor.
Lower the dumbbell back to the starting position in a controlled manner. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the left arm.
tips: Maintain a slight bend in your elbow to protect your joints.
Focus on using your shoulder muscles to lift the weight, not your biceps.
Exhale as you raise the dumbbell and inhale as you lower it.
results.description: Dumbbell Single Arm Underhand Front Raise is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Biceps, Chest.

results.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Upright Row
instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder width apart and hold a dumbbell in front of your thigh using an overhand grip. Keep your free arm relaxed by your side.
Pull the dumbbell upward close to your torso by leading with your elbow and moving it outward and upward.
Raise the dumbbell toward your upper chest until your elbow is higher than your wrist.
Slowly lower the dumbbell along the same path until your arm is fully extended, then repeat before switching sides.
tips: Lead the pull with your elbow rather than lifting with your hand.
Avoid using momentum or shrugging excessively to lift the weight.
Keep your torso upright and avoid leaning backward as the dumbbell rises.
Exhale as you raise the dumbbell and inhale as you lower it.
results.description: Dumbbell Single Arm Upright Row is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Biceps, Forearms, Core.

results.name: Dumbbell Standing Alternate Overhead Press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height with your palms facing each other.
Press the right dumbbell overhead until your arm is fully extended while keeping the left dumbbell at shoulder height.
Lower the right dumbbell back to shoulder height and then press the left dumbbell overhead until your left arm is fully extended.
Continue alternating the press between your right and left arms for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure your back remains straight and avoid leaning backward during the press.
Exhale as you press the dumbbell overhead and inhale as you lower it back down.
Use a controlled motion to avoid jerking the weights and maintain proper form.
results.description: Dumbbell Standing Alternate Overhead Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Upper Chest.
